title: Data Analyst - Contract - Visualisation
text: Data Analyst - Contract - Visualisation at Sirius Technology Melbourne part of Sirius People Pty Ltd (Melbourne, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). You will be responsible for the analysing customer data. You will need to draw on your dynamic, driven and technical abilities to be successful in this role. Your main duties will be providing reports and analytical solutions for the business. This will include the development and translation of user requirements into specifications for complex logical data models and source data capture. Ideally you need to have strong communication skills and proven experience gathering requirements from stakeholders and presenting the data in a meaningful way (storytelling). Benefits: 6 month contract Immediate start CBD location Key Responsibilities: Technical requirements gathering in relation to database/server migrations Present data in a meaningful way - data visualisation High level engagement with stakeholders at all stages Some hands on database work - ETL, queries etc. Concept verification and solution recommendation Process analysis and improvement Identifies, documents and validates data migration scope, risks, constraints, dependencies and assumptions Engages key users and stakeholders in defining data migration requirements Identifies, documents and validates data migration requirements, technology and IT infrastructure requirements and expectations The successful candidates needs to demonstrate: Bachelor's Degree in business, IT or related discipline. Demonstrated background developing solutions using SSIS, SSRS, Tableau and with SQL and relational databases. Experience in other visualisation tools may be considered. Proficient in macros Work efficiently in a dynamic environment with all levels of internal stakeholders Proven decision making ability under pressure Strong critical thinking, organizational, interpersonal communication, multi-tasking and prioritizing skills. Demonstrate a passion for and understanding of our company's customers' deadlines. Demonstrated experience working in a gaming or wagering industry or demonstrates a passion for sports industry. To be considered you must have full Australian working rights as the role may be extended and there is no opportunity for extension. Ideally you need to be available immediately. If you meet the above requirements and are available now please APPLY NOW. For further information contact Donna Bowen on 03 9020 1994.
